theater: 河南蔡州城與汝水兩岸

battle.name: 蔡州之戰
battle.theater: 河南蔡州城與汝水兩岸
battle.brief: 金哀宗自汴京退保蔡州，蒙古軍築長壘合圍，築柴潭斷城中汲水，砲壓城頭；宋將孟珙率兵決柴潭引汝水灌城，三月而城破，金朝覆亡。卡面維京長斧所屬窄刃長斧譜系，於攻城序列中以劈門伐木的工具身分延續，城頭真正交鋒的是弩與砲。

kit.name: 維京長斧
kit.history: 刃很長，斧面窄。北歐的船隊帶著它，也帶著它上岸。

countries: 蔡州城下的交戰方是三方：蒙古帝國、南宋與金朝。金國一方，宣宗以來在中原建起的漢地軍政體系已隨潼關以西與河北的相繼失守而解體；哀宗退保蔡州後，以南京留守司為中樞，糾集自汴京、歸德、鄧州一路退下的散兵、各路星夜赴援的兵馬，以及新募的忠孝軍民兵，真正能連續作戰的兵力不足一萬，缺馬缺甲，能撐住陣線的只有城頭的弓弩手與城內的近身短兵，器械則以弩與石砲為主，攻城用的撞木、拒馬多屬臨時徵集之物。蒙古一方，大汗窩闊台居中統帥，前線由宗王塔察兒率蒙軍主攻，速不台等蒙古諸部配合，漢地降附的步卒與回回工匠隨軍供應攻城技術與器械，糧秣多由已降的河南各州就地徵發，騎兵在平原上封鎖四野，步卒與工匠則填壕、架梯、施砲。南宋一方，理宗朝在樞密院推動聯蒙古滅金之議，十一月與蒙古達成聯軍滅金的協議，十二月由荊湖前線出兵，統軍主帥督率，孟珙、江海分道為前鋒，並配給糧食三十萬石。故此城下形成蒙古主攻、宋軍助攻、金軍死守的局面；三方指揮體系的落差同樣明顯：蒙古與南宋各有專責的攻城與助攻城分遣隊，而金廷的每一道決策仍要經留守司與宮禁文書層層傳遞。
countriesEn: Three parties stood beneath the walls of Caizhou: the Mongol Empire, the Southern Song and the Jin court. On the Jin side, the Han Chinese military-administrative system that the Xuanzong Emperor had built up across the Central Plain had come apart with the successive loss of everything west of Tong Pass and of Hebei; after Aizong withdrew to Caizhou, the resident commission of the southern capital became the centre of government, gathering the stragglers who fell back from Bianjing, Guide and Dengzhou, the troops hurried in from the various circuits, and newly raised militia known as the zhongxiao jun. The troops actually able to fight continuously numbered fewer than ten thousand; horses and armour were short, and the only formations that could hold a line were the crossbowmen on the walls and the troops with hand weapons inside the inner city, their equipment resting mainly on crossbows and stone catapults, while the battering beams and cheval-de-frise used against assault were hastily collected. On the Mongol side the Great Khan Ogedei was the supreme commander, the front was led by the prince Tachar with the Mongol columns of Subutai and others cooperating, Han Chinese auxiliaries and Muslim craftsmen marched with them to supply siegecraft, engineers and tools, and the grain was largely requisitioned on the spot from the Henan prefectures that had already submitted; cavalry sealed the open country on all four sides while foot soldiers and artisans filled the ditches, raised ladders and worked the catapults. On the Southern Song side the Privy Council of the Lizong court pushed the policy of destroying Jin in league with the Mongols; an agreement for joint war was concluded in the eleventh month, and in the twelfth month troops came out from the Jinghu front under the overall commander, with Meng Gong and Jiang Hai leading separate columns as the van, and a ration of 300,000 shi of grain was allotted. The result was a single city besieged by three parties: the Mongols attacking, the Song assisting, the Jin holding out. The gap between the three command systems was just as plain: the Mongols and the Song each had detachments assigned specifically to the siege and to assisted siege, whereas every decision in the Jin camp still had to travel by paper through the liushou si and the palace offices.
people: 金哀宗完顏守緒是這一場戰爭的中心人物。他早年在1214年被立為太子，1224年即位，一二三三年正月汴京失守後放棄抵抗，退保蔡州，以該城為南京。圍城三個多月，糧盡援絕，他對侍臣說自己為金紫十年、太子十年、人主十年，自知無大過惡，死無恨怨，所恨只是祖宗傳祚百年而斷於己手，又說自古無不亡之國，亡國之君往往為人囚繫或受辱於階庭，斷然表示必不至於此。城破前夜，他傳位給東面元帥完顏承麟，詔書說自己以肌體肥重不便鞍馬馳突，願以承麟之趫捷有將略，若能脫身使祚胤不絕，即是自己心志。完顏承麟是東面元帥，即位典禮剛完成便率軍出戰，力不能回，退保蔡州子城，聞哀宗死訊即與大臣哭奠，哭未畢而城破，被亂軍所殺，金朝就此滅亡。外圍的將領各自分散覆滅：武仙在息州方向被蒙宋聯軍擊敗，萬奴被擒；宿州副總帥高剌哥戰死在破外城之役，都尉王愛實戰死在西城之役。砲軍總帥王銳於十二月十九日殺元帥夾谷當哥，率三十人降蒙，這一叛降直接暴露了金軍攻城器械調度上的破口。蒙古主帥塔察兒主導圍城，《史集》記載他最後只分得金哀宗的一隻手。孟珙是宋軍的主攻前鋒，率兵萬人，與襄軍將領江海同為宋方主將，十二月初七主持決柴潭引汝水灌城，攻破之後又與塔察兒分割金哀宗遺骸，率大部歸宋。端平元年收復河南之役的督軍人物，各書記載互有出入，據宋方紀事，樞密院所遣之師以趙葵總督，與孟珙、江海同赴蔡州。
peopleEn: The Aizong Emperor of Jin, Wanyan Shouxu, was the central figure of the war. He was made heir in 1214 and took the throne in 1224; after Bianjing fell in the first month of 1233 he gave up resistance and withdrew to Caizhou, making that city his southern capital. Trapped for more than three months with no grain and no relief, he told his courtiers that he had been a prince of the blood for ten years, a crown prince for ten years and a ruler for ten years, that he knew of no great fault of his own and bore no grudge against his end, and that what he regretted was only that a hundred years of transmitted fortune had been cut off with him; he added that in all ages there was no state that did not perish, that the ruler of a fallen state was usually kept in bonds or paraded before the victors as a captive, and vowed firmly that he would not come to that. On the night before the city fell he passed the throne to his eastern commander Wanyan Chenglin, saying in the edict that his own body was heavy and ill-suited to riding and charging, that Chenglin was quick and had the makings of a general, and that if the line of the house could by him be preserved, that was his intention. Wanyan Chenglin was the eastern commander; the ceremony of his accession was barely finished when he led his men out to fight, could not hold the line, and fell back into the inner city of Caizhou. On hearing of Aizong's death he wept with his ministers, and before the mourning was over the wall was broken and he was killed by the soldiers, which ended the Jin dynasty. The commanders on the outer ring were destroyed one by one: Wuxian was beaten at Xizhou by the Mongol-Song combined force and Wannu was taken; Suizhou deputy commander Bolige died fighting when the outer city was stormed, and the commandant Wang Aishi died in the fighting over the western wall. On the nineteenth day of the twelfth month the artillery commander Wang Rui killed the marshal Jiagudangge and surrendered to the Mongols with thirty men, a defection that laid bare the flaw in the Jin command of their own siege engines. The Mongol commander Tachar directed the investment, and the Rashid al-Din's Jami al-Tawarikh records that in the end he received only one of Aizong's hands. Meng Gong was the assaulting vanguard of the Song force, leading ten thousand men, and together with Jiang Hai, a general of the Xiang army, he was one of the Song commanders; on the seventh day of the twelfth month he opened the Chaitan dam to let the Ru river flood the city, and after the fall he divided the emperor's remains with Tachar, carrying the greater part back to Song territory. The commanders in overall charge of the Duanping-era recovery of Henan are recorded differently in different books, but the Song accounts name Zhao Kui as the commander of the force dispatched, going to Caizhou together with Meng Gong and Jiang Hai.
kits: 卡面這件維京長斧是丹麥斧，約十一世紀北歐的雙手窄刃長斧：刃長而斧面窄，柄長過肩，靠雙手與全身重量揮砍，本為步戰破甲而造，須與大盾相配才得施展，是北歐步戰冷兵器譜系中的代表兵器。它不會出現在蔡州城頭，十三世紀的東亞攻城戰由另一套技術主導，這一點必須說清楚；但它仍能在裝備體系中找到自己的位置。第一，作為窄刃長斧的高階形態，它屬於斧類冷兵器，而斧類在攻城序列裡從來沒有退場：劈砍城門鐵葉、斬斷門樑橫木、砍伐雲梯支柱與鹿角拒馬，都是這類窄刃工具斧的分內事，蒙古軍在蔡州用來拆壘、破門、斷梯的正是同一族工具。第二，作為對照，它把裝備技術的世代差講得很清楚：守城的骨架是弩，蒙古的角弓是反曲複合弓，騎兵佩蒙古彎刀、長柄薙刀與標槍，著札甲與皮甲、馬具鎧甲，攻城方則配有雲梯、擋子牌、撞車、破城槌、投石砲與攻城用的穴地掘進；金軍的十字弩與勁弩在城頭構成唯一可靠火力，另有撞木、拒馬、滾木礌石與女牆後的臨時街壘，忠孝軍民兵多持農具與短兵。金軍攻城器械的調度也見於記載，砲軍總帥王銳一職正說明蔡州攻防兩端都有成建制的砲兵，而元軍的砲兵則由回回工匠主持器械。宋軍除弩手與步軍外，還有自江漢沿水路北運的糧秣三十萬石，行程逾千里，腳力車船的補給線比攻城本身更考驗組織。回頭看，這件兵器提供的是一條清晰的技術座標：歐亞戰場的重心已由斧盾步兵轉向弩砲與騎射，蔡州正是這一轉型的實景。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Dane axe, the two-handed narrow-bladed long axe of eleventh-century northern Europe: a long blade on a narrow head, a haft longer than a man's shoulder, swung with both hands and the weight of the whole body, built for breaking armour in close combat and only effective when paired with a large shield. It is the representative weapon of the Nordic family of close-quarter cold arms. It would never appear on the walls of Caizhou, for the thirteenth-century East Asian siege was dominated by a different body of technique, and that must be said plainly; yet the weapon still has a place in the system of equipment. First, as the developed form of the narrow-bladed long axe, it belongs to the axe family, and the axe family has never left the siege line: splitting the iron sheathing of a gate, cutting through the beams that barred it, felling the props of scaling ladders and the sharpened stakes of a cheval-de-frise were all the work of this narrow-headed tool axe, and the tools the Mongols used at Caizhou to smash the barricades, breach the gates and break the ladders belonged to exactly the same family. Second, as a contrast it states the generational gap in technique plainly: the backbone of the defence was the crossbow, the Mongol bow was a recurved composite, the cavalry carried the Mongol sabre, the long-handled bill and the lance, and wore lamellar and leather armour with horse harness and barding; the besiegers had scaling ladders, mantlets, battering rams, wall-breakers, stone-throwing catapults and mining under the walls. The Jin crossbows and heavy crossbows were the only reliable fire on the walls, backed by battering beams, cheval-de-frise, rolling logs and stones, and by improvised street barricades behind the parapet, while the zhongxiao jun militia carried farm tools and hand weapons. The Jin siege-train is also documented, and the post of artillery commander held by Wang Rui shows that both sides at Caizhou fielded organised train crews, the Mongol engines being handled by Muslim craftsmen. The Song besides crossbowmen and foot soldiers brought grain of 300,000 shi up from the Jiang-Han by water, a journey of more than a thousand li, so that the line of supply tested the organisation more than the siege itself did. In the end the weapon offers a clear technical coordinate: the centre of gravity of the Eurasian battlefield had already shifted from axe-and-shield infantry to crossbow, artillery and mounted archery, and Caizhou is a perfect illustration of that shift.
tactics: 蒙古軍的圍城是一套完整程序。1233年九月築長壘，把蔡州四周合圍成一道弧形封線，壘後設營壘，壘內通騎兵巡邏，目的有三：斷絕城中糧道、封住所有出城的路、擋住從南面與東面可能趕到的援兵；同時在內線布哨，監視每一次突圍嘗試。柴潭是關鍵一手：蒙軍在汝水下游亦稱練江的水路上築壩攔水，斷了城中汲水之路，城內水井漸涸；12月7日宋將孟珙反手決開柴潭，水勢轉入汝水，反用來灌蔡州城，攻守之勢由此逆轉，蒙古軍隨即改以砲壓城頭、進逼城基。進攻採分道：塔察兒率蒙軍自西面主攻，孟珙率宋軍自南面助攻，兩軍內防金軍突圍，外阻各路援兵，聯防與圍攻同時進行。攻城手段是複合的：奪取城外白坡一帶高地築砲居高臨下，砲擊城頭女牆，再以雲梯、撞車、破城槌貼城，同時在城牆根部掘進穴地，把地道逼到城內；守方則以十字弩居高壓制登梯者，以撞木、拒馬、飛石、滾木封住缺口，並用臨時街壘把內城切成一段段，逐次退守。12月9日蒙古軍破外城，19日破西城，同日砲軍總帥王銳殺元帥夾谷當哥率三十人降蒙，等於城頭火力的調度環節自行崩壞；24日哀宗自東城突圍不成，被迫退入子城；1234年正月初九夜傳位完顏承麟，初十南面守軍不支，宋軍入城，金軍在街巷中抵抗，蒙軍四面合擊，子城隨之陷落。
tacticsEn: The Mongol investment was carried out as a complete procedure. In the ninth month of 1233 they built a long palisade, closing Caizhou in an arc and stringing a line of camps behind it with a causeway for the cavalry to patrol inside, and this served three purposes: to cut the grain route into the city, to seal every road out of it, and to block any relief that might come from the south or the east; pickets were posted on the inner line to watch every attempt to break out. The Chaitan was the decisive measure: the Mongols threw a dam across the lower Ru, also called the Lian river, cutting the city off from its water supply and slowly drying the wells within; on the seventh day of the twelfth month the Song general Meng Gong opened the Chaitan from the other side, the water swung into the Ru and was turned to flood the walls of Caizhou, and the balance of the siege was reversed, the Mongols then pressing the parapets with their catapults and closing on the base of the wall. The attack was conducted in separate columns: Tachar led the Mongols in the main attack from the west while Meng Gong led the Song force in an assisted attack from the south, and the two forces together kept watch against a Jin breakout on the inside and against relief columns on the outside, defence and investment proceeding at the same time. The assault was composite: the heights around Baipo outside the city were taken so that catapults could be emplaced to shoot down at the walls, the parapets were battered from above, scaling ladders, battering rams and wall-breakers were brought up against the wall, and at the same time mine galleries were driven forward at the foot of the rampart to push a tunnel inside the defences. The defenders answered with crossbows firing down on the men on the ladders, with battering beams, cheval-de-frise, stones and rolling logs sealing the breaches, and with improvised street barricades that cut the inner city into sections, yielding ground stage by stage. On the ninth day of the twelfth month the Mongols broke the outer city; on the nineteenth they broke the western wall, and on the same day the artillery commander Wang Rui killed the marshal Jiagudangge and surrendered to the Mongols with thirty men, which meant the mechanism directing the fire of the walls had collapsed of its own accord. On the twenty-fourth the emperor's attempted breakout from the eastern gate failed and he was driven back into the inner city; on the ninth day of the first month of 1234 he passed the throne to Wanyan Chenglin, and on the tenth the southern defenders gave way, the Song entered the city, the Jin fought in the streets, the Mongols struck from four sides and the inner city was taken.
data: 圍城的時間軸有明確紀錄。1233年九月蒙古軍築長壘合圍，1234年正月城破，前後約三個月，跨年百餘日。逐日可考者：十二月初七蒙軍決練江、宋兵決柴潭引水灌城；十二月初九蒙古軍破外城，宿州副總帥高剌哥戰死；十二月十九蒙古軍破西城，都尉王愛實戰死，同日砲軍總帥王銳殺夾谷當哥率三十人降蒙；十二月二十四金哀宗自東城突圍失敗；1234年正月初九夜傳位完顏承麟，正月初十城破，金朝亡。兵員方面，蒙古與宋方聯軍投入的攻城與助攻兵力當在數萬之數，據記錄宋軍出動萬人、隨軍配糧三十萬石；金軍方面，記載有限，可確定的只是守城兵力不足一萬，多為退下來的散兵與新募民兵，能連續作戰者僅城頭弓弩手與近身短兵。支援面同樣有數可記：十二月初蒙古軍在息州擊敗武仙，海州、沂州、萊州、濰州等州相繼降蒙，蔡州的外援路線至此斷絕。空間尺度上，汴京至蔡州直線逾二百公里，蔡州至三峰山三百餘公里，騎兵可數日而至，步卒負重行軍則需數倍時間；守城弩的有效射程在百步上下，強弩可及二百步，蒙古弓陣在二百步外放箭可迫使守軍縮回女牆之後，砲的射程更達數百步，攻城方得以在弩程之外先手毀傷城頭器械。背景數字可作對照：1232年正月三峰山之戰，金國十五萬大軍覆沒；同年正月蒙古軍圍汴京，1233年正月汴京、中京相繼陷落。金哀宗自述金紫十年、太子十年、人主十年，前後三十年。
dataEn: The chronology of the siege is firmly recorded. In the ninth month of 1233 the Mongols built their long palisade and closed the ring; the city fell in the first month of 1234, so the investment lasted about three months and ran across the turn of the year for more than a hundred days. The days can be traced: on the seventh day of the twelfth month the Mongols opened the Lian channel while the Song troops burst the Chaitan to flood the city; on the ninth the Mongols broke the outer city and Suizhou deputy commander Bolige was killed; on the nineteenth they broke the western wall and commandant Wang Aishi fell, and on the same day the artillery commander Wang Rui killed Jiagudangge and surrendered with thirty men; on the twenty-fourth the Aizong Emperor's attempt to break out through the eastern gate failed; on the ninth night of the first month of 1234 he passed the throne to Wanyan Chenglin, and on the tenth the city was taken and the Jin ended. On numbers of troops, the Mongol and Song besieging and assisting forces must be counted in the tens of thousands, the records giving ten thousand Song soldiers with a ration of 300,000 shi of grain; on the Jin side the record is thin, and the only certainty is that the garrison numbered fewer than ten thousand, composed mostly of stragglers who had fallen back and freshly raised militia, the only troops able to fight continuously being the crossbowmen on the walls and those with hand weapons inside. The relief picture is equally documented: in the early twelfth month the Mongols beat Wuxian at Xizhou and the prefectures of Haizhou, Yizhou, Laizhou and Weizhou surrendered in turn, which cut the last lines of support to Caizhou. In scale, the direct line from Bianjing to Caizhou runs to more than two hundred kilometres and to Sanfengshan to more than three hundred; cavalry could cover that in a matter of days, while foot soldiers carrying their loads needed several times as long. The effective range of the defenders' crossbows was of the order of a hundred paces, with heavy crossbows reaching two hundred, and the Mongol bow line could loose at two hundred paces to drive the defenders back behind the parapet, while catapults reached several hundred paces and let the besiegers destroy the weapons on the walls from beyond even the range of the crossbows. For comparison, in the first month of 1232 the Jin army of 150,000 was annihilated at Sanfengshan; in the same month the Mongols invested Bianjing, and in the first month of 1233 Bianjing and Zhongdu fell in turn. Aizong himself counted ten years as a prince of the blood, ten as crown prince and ten as ruler, thirty years in all.
cause: 金朝走到蔡州，是五年之間連續三場大戰把國力抽乾的結果。1231年拖雷假道宋境、繞出唐州鄧州攻取關中，潼關以西盡失；1232年正月三峰山一戰，十五萬大軍在暴雪中崩潰，主力裝備散盡；同年正月蒙古軍直抵汴京，金廷靠守城擊退一次進攻，卻從此失去再戰的意願，汴京、中京相繼陷落。內部早已空虛：皇族內鬥與宮廷變故耗損中樞，紅袷軍一類叛亂與地方武裝割據牽制了本可徵發的兵員，財政因交鈔濫發與賦稅難收而崩壞，號稱河北軍的簽軍與鄉兵裝備訓練參差，遇大軍即潰。哀宗退保蔡州，是因為汴京以南只剩這一處有城有糧有汝水可守；而蒙古軍必欲拔除此城，理由同樣清楚：蔡州是中原南面的最後一處金國據點，拔掉它，蒙古才能把河南連成一片，消滅南宋北面的屏障。蒙古對宋則另有算盤——1233年十一月訂下的聯軍滅金協議，讓南宋兵馬自南面包抄，自河漢運糧供應；宋廷也想藉蒙古之勢收復河南，又不必單獨承擔與蒙古全面開戰的風險，於是雙方各有各的算盤，共同把箭頭指向蔡州。金廷在城破之前只剩兩條路：出城決戰，或者死守待援，而援兵已無。
causeEn: The Jin court came to Caizhou because three great battles in five years drained the state dry. In 1231 Tolui borrowed passage through Song territory, swung through Tangzhou and Dengzhou, and took the Guanzhong region, so that everything west of Tong Pass was lost; in the first month of 1232 the army of 150,000 collapsed in a blizzard at Sanfengshan and the main body of its equipment was lost; in the same month the Mongols stood before Bianjing, and although the defenders beat off one assault the court lost all will to fight again, and Bianjing and Zhongdu fell in turn. The state had long been hollow within: quarrels in the imperial clan and coups at court had eaten away at the centre, revolts such as the honggu jun and regional armed risings tied down the very troops that could have been levied, the finances had collapsed under indiscriminate issue of paper money and the failure of tax collection, and the hastily enrolled Hebei army, soldiers conscripted and of local levies, was uneven in equipment and drill and broke before a full army. Aizong withdrew to Caizhou because south of Bianjing there was no other place with walls, grain and the Ru river to hold; and the Mongols had to take the city for reasons just as clear: Caizhou was the last Jin foothold in the southern Central Plain, and until it fell the Mongols could not join Henan into one block nor remove the screen that shielded the Song from the north. The Mongols had their own arithmetic for the Song: the agreement for joint war against Jin concluded in the eleventh month of 1233 let Song troops strike from the south and bring grain up the rivers; the Song court, for its part, wanted to use the weight of the Mongol advance to recover Henan without bearing the whole cost of a general war with the Mongols. Each side therefore had its own calculation, and both pointed their arrows at Caizhou. By the time the walls were broken the Jin court had only two roads left: to sortie and fight, or to hold out for relief that no longer existed.
impact: 蔡州陷落首先意味著一個斷代：1234年之後，中原再無一個可以號令北方、以正統自居的政權，蒙古對華北與河南的統治從此連成一片，漢地千戶制與行省式的編制得以在沒有金廷阻力的地面上鋪開。對南宋而言，這是一場災難性的轉折：北方那道由金朝撐起來的屏障消失，1235年之後蒙古分路南下，兩淮、荊湖、四川三面同時受兵，端平年間宋軍一度收復的河南、兩河州郡很快盡失，南宋從此只能在襄陽、兩淮與四川三條線上做守禦布置；襄陽自此成為必爭之地，1267年之後的襄陽之戰、1273年襄陽陷落、1276年鄂州失守一路推到1279年崖山滅宋，線索清清楚楚。技術面上，這一戰是蒙古第一次在漢地大型城垣下把工匠、砲、投石機、水攻與穴地掘進合為一體；二十餘年後攻襄陽時所用的巨砲，源頭正落在蔡州這樣的攻城實驗上。而聯軍合作本身也是禍根：蒙古因此看清了南宋的虛實，南宋也第一次真正站在蒙古的砲口前，享受了收復失地的虛名，卻種下了北方再無屏障的隱憂。史料層面，《金史》哀宗本紀、《宋史》理宗本紀與理宗列傳、《元史》太宗本紀，以及伊本阿西爾塔爾卡的《史集》，從金、宋、蒙、波斯四個方向留下了詳略互見的記錄；兵器史上，這一戰則標示著斧盾步兵體系在東亞退位、弩砲與騎射取而代之的年代到來。
impactEn: The fall of Caizhou first marked a break in the historical record: after 1234 there was no longer any authority in the north that could claim the Central Plain and hold it as legitimate, and the Mongol rule over northern China and Henan became one continuous block, so that the decimal organisation of Han districts and the apparatus of provincial administration could be laid out over ground no longer obstructed by a Jin court. For the Southern Song it was a disastrous turning point: the screen held up in the north by the Jin dynasty disappeared, and after 1235 the Mongols came south by several routes, pressing northern Song on the Huai, in Jinghu and in Sichuan at once, while the Henan and Two Rivers prefectures the Song had briefly recovered during the Duanping years were soon lost again, leaving the Southern Song nothing but a defensive line in Xiangyang, on the Huai and in Sichuan. Xiangyang was from that moment a place that had to be held; the fighting there after 1267, its fall in 1273, the loss of Ezhou in 1276 and the end of the Song at Yamen in 1279 all follow in an unbroken thread from that point. On the technical side, this was the first time the Mongols had combined craftsmen, catapults, stone-throwing engines, water attack and mining into a single method against the great walled cities of the Han heartland, and the great engines used against Xiangyang more than twenty years later grew directly out of experiments of this kind at Caizhou. The alliance itself was also a root of future misfortune: the Mongols saw clearly how weak the Song was, the Song stood for the first time genuinely in front of the Mongol artillery, won the empty credit of recovering lost territory, and planted the seed of the day when the north would have no shield at all. In the historical record, the Aizong annals of the Jin History, the Lizong annals and biographies of the Song History, the Taizong annals of the Yuan History, and the Jami al-Tawarikh of Ibn Athid al-Din preserve the event from four directions, Jin, Song, Mongol and Persian, in unequal detail; in the history of arms it marks the arrival of the age in which axe-and-shield infantry gave way in East Asia to crossbow, artillery and mounted archery.
result: 1234年正月初十，蔡州城破。蒙古軍破西城、掃平外城之後四面合擊，宋軍自南面入城，金軍在街巷中作最後抵抗而不能支持；金哀宗在初九夜已自縊於幽蘭軒，完顏承麟在初十即位當日出戰，退保子城，城破被殺，金朝至此滅亡。城中官屬多投汝水殉國，女真權貴亦有自戕者，宿州副總帥高剌哥、都尉王愛實等將領先後戰死，砲軍總帥王銳等叛降蒙古，殘存兵眾或死或擒。蒙軍入城後收繳蔡州府庫、軍械與糧秣，宋軍亦分取金人輜重，並將金哀宗遺骸押回臨安告太廟，舉國慶祝金國覆亡——《史集》所載塔察兒僅得其一隻手，正是這場劫掠式分割的寫照。對蒙古而言，滅金大局至此完成，隨即轉兵東南，五年之間兩淮、荊襄與四川相繼開戰；對南宋而言，收復蔡州的代價是北方再無屏障，而金哀宗那道傳位詔書，成為中原最後一段正統的終結。
resultEn: On the tenth day of the first month of 1234 the city of Caizhou fell. After the Mongols had broken the western wall and swept the outer city they struck from four sides, the Song entered from the south, and the Jin fought a last stand in the streets without being able to hold. The Aizong Emperor had already hanged himself in the Youlan Hall on the night of the ninth, and on the tenth Wanyan Chenglin, who had taken the throne that same morning, led his men out to fight, fell back into the inner city, and was killed when it was taken; the Jin dynasty ended there and then. Officials of the city threw themselves into the Ru river, and there were Manchu nobles who killed themselves rather than surrender; commanders such as Suizhou deputy commander Bolige and the commandant Wang Aishi had already fallen in the fighting, the artillery commander Wang Rui and others defected to the Mongols, and what was left of the garrison was killed or taken. After entering the city the Mongols seized the treasure, weapons and grain of the Caizhou treasury, the Song troops took their share of the Jin booty, and the remains of the Aizong Emperor were carried back to Lin'an to be announced in the imperial ancestral temple, the whole realm rejoicing over the fall of Jin; the note in the Jami al-Tawarikh that Tachar received only one of the emperor's hands is an exact image of that plundered division. For the Mongols the destruction of Jin was complete, and they turned their arms south-east at once, opening war in the Two Rivers, in Jingxiang and in Sichuan within five years; for the Southern Song the price of recovering Caizhou was the loss of every screen in the north, and the Aizong Emperor's last edict of abdication became the end of the last legitimate claim in the Central Plain.
